description: Fix window_sums(values, width) to return sums of every contiguous full window of the given positive width. Return an empty list when the width exceeds the input length.
initial_source:
def window_sums(values, width):
    return [sum(values[i:i+width]) for i in range(len(values)-width)]
reference_source:
def window_sums(values, width):
    return [sum(values[i:i+width]) for i in range(len(values)-width+1)]
